blocks.text: Requirement gathering SDLC ka pehla marhala hai. Maqsad yeh samajhna aur jama karna hai ke software ko kya hasil karna hai, un logon se baat kar ke jo ise istemal karenge aur doosre stakeholders (mutalliqa afraad) se, ta ke un ki zarooratein aur tawaqqoaat maloom hon. Maslan agar aap school ke liye nayi app bana rahe hain to students, teachers aur administrators se pooch sakte hain ke woh kaunsi features dekhna chahte hain.

items: Interviews aur surveys: mumkina users se sawal poochna aur raaye jama karna ta ke un ki zarooratein aur pasand samjhi ja sake.
Observations (mushahida): dekhna ke users maujooda nizam ke saath kaise kaam karte hain ta ke masail aur behtari ke mauqe pehchane ja sakein.
Document review: maujooda dastavezat, jaise reports aur user manuals, dekhna ta ke requirements ke baare mein mazeed maloomat mile.

blocks.text: Requirement gathering kisi bari taqreeb, jaise shaadi, ki mansooba bandi jaisa hai: jaise dulha dulhan ki pasand jaanna zaroori hai, waise hi developers ko jaanna zaroori hai ke users software se kya chahte hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Requirement gathering ki teen aham sargarmiyan bataiye aur har ek ka kaam bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Interviews aur surveys users ki zarooratein aur pasand seedhe jama karte hain; observations dikhate hain ke users maujooda nizam ke saath kaise kaam karte hain aur us ke masail kahan hain; document review maujooda reports aur manuals se mazeed maloomat jama karta hai.

items: Requirement gathering: SDLC ka pehla marhala; users aur stakeholders se maloom karna ke software ko kya hasil karna hai.
Sargarmiyan: interviews aur surveys, observations, document review.
